description_en: Queries fine-grained monitoring data of a disk
description_zh: 查询单个云盘的秒级监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-disk-monitor-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --start-time 2022-06-01T03:00:00Z --end-time 2022-06-01T05:00:00Z --period 5 --type basic --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiskMonitorData

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the disk
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range during which you want to query the near real-time monitoring data of the disk. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取云盘的秒级监控数据的起始时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range during which you want to query the near real-time monitoring data of the disk. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取云盘的秒级监控数据的结束时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为0
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which the near real-time monitoring data is collected. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

5
60

Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh:
获取云盘的秒级监控数据的间隔时间。单位：秒。取值范围：

5。
60。

默认值：5
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The type of the monitoring data. Valid values:

basic: baseline performance data.
pro: burst performance data, such as burst I/O operations
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘监控数据类型。取值范围：

basic：基础性能数据。

pro：包含Burst IO数据
parameters.name: type
